value: ethylene gas injected into soil induced germination of pearl-millet-strain seed: 1.5 kg ai/ha gave more germination in Gardud clay than in Qoz sand, 3.0 kg ai/ha did better in Qoz than Gardud; best injection depth 15 cm in Gardud and 30 cm in Qoz; seed population cut 67% (Gardud) and 34% (Qoz)
method: field injection of ethylene gas into two Sudanese soils, with germination measured as loss of viable seed (suicidal germination)
conditions: North Kordofan, Sudan; Gardud (noncracking clay pediplain) and Qoz (stabilized sand); pearl-millet strain of S. hermonthica

method: germination tests of scarified and unscarified seeds after cold stratification at several incubation temperatures, with light and dark comparisons
conditions: seeds of a rare heathland population in northwestern Europe; null light result applies after PY and PD are broken
